description: 人工合成的小样本验证集，未发表于真实期刊；出处只用于事后核对，不传给自动检索器。

cases.title: 上一轮期刊会议混合回归

parts.text: Synthetic benchmark: regularization and stable optimization across publication venues.
Deep neural nets with a large number of parameters are very powerful machine learning systems.
This synthetic experiment connects regularization with optimization, but it does not claim to represent a published scientific study.
Training Deep Neural Networks is complicated by the fact that the distribution of each layer’s inputs changes during training.
The benchmark deliberately combines small excerpts from different publication venues with independently written transition sentences.
The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks in an encoder-decoder configuration.
本测试把期刊、会议与公开作者版本中的短片段混合，检查检索覆盖和逐句定位，不把搜索不到的内容判定为原创。
We measure whether the checker can discover those sources automatically rather than being handed the expected web addresses.
测试结果应分别报告开放全文与摘要覆盖，避免把只有论文标题的检索结果当作全文证据。
